Suggested dealer merchandising strategy

Use this structure to turn PediFix into a simple footcare destination inside your store.

Display ZoneProducts to IncludeCustomer QuestionSales Angle
Toe Comfort Hammer toe cushions, toe straighteners, toe wraps, toe crutches, separators. “Are your toes rubbing, curling, or hurting in your shoes?” Fast solution for common toe pain and pressure problems.
Bunion Relief Bunion guards, sleeves, shields, toe spacers, nighttime regulators. “Is your bunion rubbing against your shoe?” Protect the painful area and separate toes that rub.
Forefoot & Heel Ball-of-foot cushions, metatarsal pads, heel cups, heel sleeves. “Does it hurt under the ball of your foot or heel?” Comfort for walking, standing, and daily wear.
Arch & Insoles Arch supports, insoles, orthotic-style products. “Do your feet get tired or unsupported during the day?” Everyday comfort and support add-on next to footwear.
Skin & Fungus Care Cleansing bars, soaking crystals, creams, oils, tapes, skin repair items. “Are you dealing with dry skin, cracking, odor, or fungus concerns?” Repeat purchase category for ongoing footcare maintenance.
